attributes.action: Create a National Disability Hate Strategy for the UK
attributes.additional_details:
Disability hate is rising online and in public. 

Disabled people are abused, questioned and targeted simply for existing. 

Government must develop a National Disability Hate Strategy with Disabled People’s Organisations to prevent hate and better protect victims.
attributes.background: Develop and fund a National Disability Hate Strategy, co-produced with Disabled People’s Organisations, to tackle disability hate crime, online abuse, discrimination, public stigma and improve awareness of visible and hidden disabilities.
